override_classes.name: priority_override
override_classes.semantics: Higher explicit priority replaces lower priority conflicting rules.

override_classes.name: package_override
override_classes.semantics: A later package in the deployment set may override earlier package content when declared.

override_classes.name: version_override
override_classes.semantics: Newer compatible object version supersedes older version of the same id.

override_classes.name: project_override
override_classes.semantics: Project/tenant overlay may override shared knowledge when explicitly enabled.

resolution_algorithm: Collect all candidates that conflict_with or override the same target.
Sort by override class precedence descending.
Within the same class, sort by priority.order descending, then specificity descending, then id ascending.
Select the first candidate as winner; record losers as overridden.
Never mutate the overridden object; emit resolution metadata only.
determinism_guarantees: Same candidate set always yields the same winner.
Id ascending is the final tie-breaker.
Disabled or incompatible candidates never win.
